text:
Sam: Massive thanks to @Bea and @Malik for stepping in when the office plant toppled into the charging station this morning. You two averted a tiny disaster and rescued both the ficus and my laptop cord :seedling: :sos:
Bea: glad we caught it before sparks. Malik unplugged everything like a pro. Also shoutout to @Nora for grabbing the paper towels and that heroic zip tie :raised_hands:
Malik: teamwork! Also learned a new skill: ficus wrapping 101. 10/10 would practice again.
Nora: tiny first aid for plants and cords. sending virtual bandaids :adhesive_bandage:
infra-bot: safety note: check all shared charging stations weekly. Logged task #PLANT-CHARGE-42 assigned to Facilities. :wrench:
Sam: love this. small, human moments like this deserve a shoutout. I'll add a one-liner to the monthly kudos doc. Free coffee from my stash to Bea & Malik later :coffee:
Bea: :heart: thanks Sam. Also adding a sticky to the kitchen: "Don’t charge under plants"
Malik: sticker appreciated. Thanks everyone for the quick help.
Nora: agreed — saves the demo chaos later. Good vibes all around :sparkles:
